description: A community reference database for Once Human — weapons, mods, blueprints, builds, memetic specializations, deviants, crops, bosses, regions, and patch history.
disclaimer: Once Human is developed and published by Starry Studio / NetEase. This is an unofficial, fan-made reference site compiled from publicly available wikis, official patch notes, and community guides. Data reflects the game state as of the compile date above and may drift as the game continues to receive updates — see the Updates page for the latest patch history and check the linked sources for anything time-sensitive.

sources.name: Once Human Official Site — News & Patch Notes
